title: 1.17 Exponential growth and decay: Exponential growth and decay in context, using multipliers and finding time by trial

q.Q1: Q1. 500 bacteria grow by 30% per hour. How many after 6 hours, to the nearest whole number?

q.Q2: Q2. A drug in the blood falls by 15% each hour from 200 mg. Find the amount after 5 hours, to 1 decimal place.

q.Q3: Q3. After how many whole hours does the culture first exceed 10 000 bacteria?

q.Q4: Q4. Option A: KES 1000 rises by KES 100 each year. Option B: KES 1000 rises by 8% each year. Which is worth more after 10 years?

q.Q5: Q5. A town of 24 000 people grows by 3.5% each year. Find the population after 8 years, to the nearest hundred.
